intro.prompt: The white aircraft window shutter slides upward smoothly and reveals bright blue sky with soft clouds outside; light spills into the cabin; camera perfectly static; nothing else moves

loop.prompt: Clouds drift very slowly past the aircraft window, gentle light shimmer on the cabin wall, camera perfectly static, subtle ambient motion only

transition.prompt: The camera rushes forward straight through the aircraft window into the bright sky, the white light resolves into a bright modern airport arrivals hall where a greeter holds a small welcome sign; one continuous fast camera move, no cuts, no fade to black

transition.prompt: Fast crash zoom onto the handle of the rolling suitcase, whip pan to the right, motion blur, the image resolves outside the terminal where a black premium sedan waits with its rear door open and a driver in a dark suit holding the door; one continuous fast camera move, no cuts
